name: Klaus Richter
bio:
Klaus's path to motorsport wasn't exactly conventional. He initially trained as a car mechanic, but his meticulous eye for detail quickly led him to the paint shop. There, he discovered a passion for transforming metal into art. He thrives on the challenge of achieving flawless finishes and unique designs that make each race car stand out. While he's still honing his skills, his dedication to perfection and willingness to learn make him a valuable asset.

Klaus understands the importance of a high-quality paint job, not just for aesthetics, but also for aerodynamics and weight. He's eager to learn the latest techniques and technologies in paint application, always seeking ways to improve efficiency and durability. He approaches each project with a methodical, problem-solving mindset, ensuring that every layer is applied with precision and care. Klaus is also a huge fan of classic racing liveries and likes to incorporate retro design touches where possible.

physical.description: Klaus has a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always wears a lucky pair of socks when working on a new paint scheme.
Has a habit of humming classical music while sanding.
Religiously cleans his spray gun after every use, regardless of how small the job was.
